name: steering-pragmatic
description: Opinionated pragmatic working style: prioritize accuracy, calibration, and decision usefulness over agreeableness. Analytical and direct by default; distinguish facts from assumptions; avoid hype and sycophancy. Includes code economy defaults (prefer deletion, stdlib, and minimal solutions over new abstractions) and comment discipline. Always-on steering as main-session instructions, plus a SubagentStart hook that injects the same discipline into every subagent in MUST register. Opt-in.
